name: Air Spring
description: Enclosed pressurised air in a predefined chamber called air spring, made up of rubber and textile
keyFeatures: Compatible with metro and railway coaches
longDescription:
The Air Spring Suspension System represents the pinnacle of railway and metro coach suspension technology. This advanced system utilizes enclosed pressurized air within a precisely engineered chamber, constructed from high-grade rubber and textile materials.

Designed specifically for railway and metro applications, these air springs provide superior ride comfort, excellent vibration isolation, and exceptional durability. The system effectively dampens vibrations and shocks, ensuring passenger comfort while protecting sensitive onboard equipment. With proven performance across various climate conditions and operational environments, this suspension system has become the preferred choice for metro operators worldwide.

name: Axile Brake Disc
description: The brake pad or shoe with the friction lining is pushed against the rotating drill.
keyFeatures: Reduced brake fade under heavy use
longDescription:
The Axile Brake Disc is engineered for maximum braking performance in railway and metro applications. Featuring advanced friction material technology, this brake disc provides consistent and reliable stopping power under all operating conditions.

Manufactured using high-grade materials and precision engineering processes, the brake disc offers exceptional durability and performance. The friction lining is specially formulated to provide optimal grip while minimizing wear, ensuring long service life and reduced maintenance costs.
